notes.title: 0.10.0 Date announcement
notes.content: [h1]Hello once again, fellow Bugzers![/h1][p](I guess it’s starting to stick... in my head… maybe...)[/p][p][/p][p]It’s time once again for me to get you all hyped up for a new update! I’ll get straight to the point since it’s been so, so, [i]way[/i] too long. The update will be coming out this December — that means [b]12/12/25[/b]. This also means I need to get the public beta schmooving, so look forward to the beta branch being updated again in September.[/p][p][/p][h2]So what’s 0.10.0?[/h2][p]Yeah, about that… I added the [b]final boss[/b]. So sorry to all you plot-haters — now you actually have an antagonist to look forward to facing. Alongside that, this update is mostly [b]QOL[/b] improvements, [b]performance[/b] boosts, and some [b]major stability fixes[/b].[/p][p][/p][h2]Ok, but I’m sick of minor releases — when’s 1.0.0?[/h2][p]It’s getting there! At this pace, I’ll make it in time for the 2nd anniversary update. However, I’ve been trying to take things a little slower now that I have a job outside of working on Bugz, so expect that to be delayed at a moment’s notice.[/p][p][/p][h2]Is there literally anything to show?[/h2][p]No.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]...Hahaha — got you. Just kidding! Here are some select screenshots, just like last time![/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42748957/65390241dd7422127dd8bf5a5bfad9c297bf5d57.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42748957/0a4303064c9aba9ab403824cb31658aa9b74b0cf.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42748957/1d0e3b03d82a26783d6703a11bc81f66b81454c4.png"][/img][/carousel]

notes.title: 0.8.0 QOL Update Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Bugzerz,[/h2]
(Man I really regret typing that...)

The next massive Bugz will be coming out on 12/12 😮😮😮 to get people excited I decided to leak the development change-log so far. I also want to take this chance to formally announce the road map for future updates as it is right now, which will still be accessible in game.

Initially 0.8.0 was supposed to be a full content update. However, I realized that if I were to do that, the update would probably not come out until mid 2025🥶, and so I decided to push some well needed UI/UX, accessibility support, and general polish all up on my To-Do list. So all of the currently planned updates have been pushed down a version number (though the planed dates have remained generally the same).

Version 0.9.0 will be introducing a system currently in development called the kitchen and while I wont go into specifics, this is designed to bring the current end of progress to around level 250 or so. After that, version 0.10.0 will bring some cosmetic collectables and wrap up the story. Finally if all goes to plan that will leave 0.11.0 to finish up things that I need to do before release (problaby just bug fixes and the EA badges 🎉).

So to wrap up the notable updates until release:
0.9.0 will be the kitchen update.
0.10.0 will be cosmetics (and pets😶).
0.11.0 will be polish and cleanup.
1.0.0 will be the final non EA RELEASE!!!
